To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we produced and characterized the first intertribal hybrids between B. napus (tribe Brassiceae) and I. indigota (tribe Isatideae).
we produced intertribal somatics hybrids between Brassica and Isatis and obtained their BC1 progenies.
the first intertribal somatohybrid between Brassica napu s ( AACC ) and Isatis indigo tica ( II ) was produced and that some backcross progenies were obtained.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a novel approach to the development of novel plants with desirable traits from two distantly related species.
a novel approach for the production of intertribal hybrids and their progenies.
the production of intertribal hybrids, cytogenetic characterization and the development of BC1 progenies.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the intertribal somatics hybrids between B. napus L. and I. indigota (Fisch.)
the intertribal hybrids between B. napus L. and I. indigotic a Forsk are stable and fertile.
the hybrids obtained were of considerable value for the study of chromosome pairing and gene introgression in Brassica and Isatis.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the intertribal somatohybridization of B. napu s and I. indigoti ca was successful, and the BC1 plants from the hybrids were obtained.
the hybrids were mainly of the type B. napus + I. indig.

the intertribal somatics between B. napus (2A = 2C) and I. indigolica (2I = 2I), which are distantly related and have large chromosome differences (AACCII = IIIIII), could be obtained and their cytogenetics and molecular characters were characterized.
The main takeaway from our work is that

intertribal hybrids between B. napus (AACC) and I. indigolica (II) can be obtained by somatic hybridization and the addition of I. indigota chromosomes to B. napus can be achieved through backcrossing.
intertribal somaclonal hybrids between B. napus (AACC) and I. indigota (II) could be established and the hybrids could be further used in breeding.
intertribal somatohybridization can be a useful tool in the breeding of new varieties.
